# Cedric Stanhope

## Overview

- **Age:** Thirteen years old by Volume 4  <sub>[v1 c18 P46](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0046), [v1 c26 P4](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0004)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c18 P28](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0028)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v1 c26 P4](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0004), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011)</sub>
- **Rank:** Schoolboy  <sub>[v1 c18 P6](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0006), [v1 c20 P0](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0000)</sub>
- **Origin:** United States  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c18 P10](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0010)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c18 P2](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0002), [v1 c20 P0](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0000)</sub>
- **Titles:** Yankee  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c26 P23](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0023)</sub>

## Appearance

Cedric is a small, slim boy who appears younger than his age. He possesses a delicate, refined face, extraordinarily dark blue eyes, a full mouth with dimples at the corners, and a head of rich chestnut curls.

_Sources: [v1 c18 P8](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0008), [v1 c18 P37](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0037), [v1 c20 P8](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0008)_

## Personality

Cedric is an extraordinarily sensitive, imaginative, and perceptive boy with a deep capacity for affection. Highly creative, he invents vivid fantasy worlds of 'rock people' and writes poetry, while maintaining a sweet, polite, and manly disposition.

_Sources: [v1 c18 P8](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0008), [v1 c18 P35](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0035), [v1 c26 P19](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0019)_

## Traits

- Highly imaginative  <sub>[v1 c18 P23](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0023), [v1 c26 P19](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0019)</sub>
- Sensitive and affectionate  <sub>[v1 c18 P8](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0008), [v1 c19 P23](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0023)</sub>
- Poetic and creative  <sub>[v1 c26 P19](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0019), [v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020)</sub>
- Polite and manly  <sub>[v1 c18 P35](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0035)</sub>

## Abilities

- Inventing intricate fantasy worlds and stories  <sub>[v1 c26 P17](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0017)</sub>
- Writing poetry  <sub>[v1 c26 P19](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0019), [v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020)</sub>
- Academic aptitude  <sub>[v1 c18 P6](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0006)</sub>

## Goals

- To grow up to be a man like his father  <sub>[v1 c18 P37](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0037)</sub>
- To write poetry and express his imaginative ideas  <sub>[v1 c26 P19](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0019)</sub>

## History

Cedric came to Brierley from the United States to reside with his grandmother on the shore road. He quickly bonded with the local schoolteacher, Nell Harcourt, recognizing her as a kindred spirit who understood his imaginative nature and grief over his mother's death. During a winter night when his grandmother was away, Cedric helped nurse Posy Fay Pembroke through a severe case of croup. Later, he formed a warm friendship with Miss Rosalind Penrose of Echo Cottage. After his father returned from the States, Cedric continued to excel in school, write poetry, and participate in the local story club.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c18 P8](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0008), [v1 c18 P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v1 c18 P31](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0031), [v1 c19 P79](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0079), [v1 c19 P97](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0097), [v1 c26 P19](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0019), [v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020)_

## Background by volume

- Born in the United States to Stephen Stanhope and his late wife  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c19 P23](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0023)</sub>
- Lost his mother at a young age, leaving a deep emotional impact on him  <sub>[v1 c18 P28](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0028), [v1 c19 P23](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0023)</sub>
- Sent to live with his paternal grandmother in Brierley, St. Brendan's Island  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c18 P10](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0010)</sub>

## Quotes

> He has set off to hook up the sorrel mare so he can head to Delford to fetch the physician. It is as clear to me as if he had spoken it aloud. Obed and I share such a deep bond that I am able to discern his mind with no words whatsoever.  <sub>[v1 c18 P23](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0023)</sub>

> Upon this final remaining hope I rely, though I dread it is useless.  <sub>[v1 c18 P33](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0033)</sub>
